description_en: Queries the status, region ID, and status modification time of Web Application Firewall (WAF) logs
description_zh: 查询用户WAF日志服务的状态、RegionId，状态修改时间等
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-waf-log-status --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-nwy3400000j --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserWafLogStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to view the current WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: indicates the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

LogRegionId.description_en:
The ID of the region where logs are stored. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: indicates China East 1 (Hangzhou).

cn-beijing: indicates China North 2 (Beijing).

cn-hongkong: indicates China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: indicates Singapore.

ap-southeast-3: indicates Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur).

ap-southeast-5: indicates Indonesia (Jakarta).

ap-southeast-6: indicates Philippines (Manila).

ap-southeast-7: indicates Thailand (Bangkok).

me-east-1: indicates UAE (Dubai).

eu-central-1: indicates Germany (Frankfurt).

us-east-1: indicates US (Virginia).

us-west-1: indicates US (Silicon Valley).

ap-northeast-1: indicates Japan (Tokyo).

ap-northeast-2: indicates South Korea (Seoul).

eu-west-1: indicates UK (London).

cn-hangzhou-finance: indicates China East 1 Hangzhou Finance Cloud.

cn-shanghai-finance-1: indicates China East 2 Shanghai Finance Cloud.

cn-shenzhen-finance: indicates China South 1 Shenzhen Finance Cloud.

The Finance Cloud regions are available only to Finance Cloud users, and Finance Cloud users can obtain only these regions

ap-southeast-7：表示泰国（曼谷）。
me-east-1：表示阿联酋（迪拜）。
eu-central-1：表示德国（法兰克福）。
us-east-1：表示美国（弗吉尼亚）。
us-west-1：表示美国（硅谷）。

LogStatus.description_en:
The status of WAF logs.

initializing: The logs are being initialized.

initialize_failed: The initialization failed.

normal: The logs are running properly.

releasing: The logs are being released.

release_failed: The release failed
LogStatus.description_zh:
用户日志服务的当前状态。
initializing：初始化中。
initialize_failed：初始化失败。
normal：正常运行。
releasing：释放中。
release_failed：释放失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

StatusUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the log status was modified. Unit: milliseconds
StatusUpdateTime.description_zh: 日志状态修改时间，单位：毫秒
